speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Under the note, as before. Sing on the breath. I am not pitching you up to see if you break.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I can hold it if I come in under the note. If I come in on it, it goes. I am not asking for the other.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The sixth, and not before. No word of hers is changed. I am not asking thee to prove it to a yard.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Nobody startles him. That was said on Tuesday, and it holds. Eyes on the line, Nick.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I am on the line. I do not need a second master to tell me the note.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then one master. Augustine has thee. I am here for the other thing, and it is not thy chest.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Say the other thing, then. He is not made of glass, and the morning is short.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Last night Garnish was told to cut the lovers to two hours and a half. The thumb-biting in the first scene is out. We walk that. We do not walk a new speech.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: The biting is out. I do not play that scene. Tell me if I am to stand nearer the noise, or further.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Further is not a new word. The street is shorter. Thou art not in the first noise, and I am not giving thee a line to fill it.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Good. A boy who is not startled does not get a new entrance to be brave in. Nick, the note is the work.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: The note I have. The sixth I can wait for. I would rather wait than be asked to be brave in a tiring-house.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Wait, then. Thou art not for the yard today. The afternoon is Egeon, and Egeon is not thy part.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: I will not count the mornings again. The sixth is the sixth. What is left of them can be named on Saturday, when the boxes are open.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Saturday may name them. I am not counting them at this peg, and I am not calling the play on before the day.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Then I am not to be told a number. I can hold a note without a number beside it.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Hold it. If anyone in this house makes a noise at you to see the trick fail, he will hear from me before he hears from the yard.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He will hear from me as well. Nobody startles thee. That is the whole of the order.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I heard it. I do not need it said as if I were the last to know my own voice.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I have said it once too often, and I will stop. Go when Augustine lets thee.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: One more pass under the note, and then the lute goes in the case. The afternoon is not yours, Nick. Leave the instrument where a play will not knock it.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: One more. I will come in under it. If I come in on it, you will hear, and I will not argue.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will hear, and I will not mend a word that is already right.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Begin.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Under the note. I have it.
